speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Acute appendicitis

The patient has reported dark urine, which raises suspicion for hepatobiliary involvement or rhabdomyolysis rather than appendicitis; however, given the classic triad of abdominal pain, fever, and nausea, appendicitis remains a primary differential. I will proceed with imaging to confirm the location of the pain and rule out gallstones or other causes of dark urine.
